Official Supabase guidance states that Dashboard SQL Editor queries receive source/user/date metadata comments. Current public Studio source exposes disable_statement_timeout for transaction/timeout handling, not a disable-comments or preserve-raw flag.

Official API documents no metadata-suppression or exact-byte flag. Official MCP already forwards query through this endpoint. Bypassing the exposed connector through a new token/API client would require access outside the current constraints and was not attempted.

Current official CLI source routes linked project queries through the same Management API and requires its existing CLI credential mechanism. No credential files or environment values were inspected, and no CLI login/link was attempted.

PostgreSQL documents that psql -c sends its command string as one request and PQexec supports a complete multi-statement command string. Supabase documents native PostgreSQL client connections. Such a client can submit the unchanged full file, including final LF, without changing the validator. No existing authorized production native connection is exposed or confirmed here.
